title: Pariññeyyā
text: 1-2 Sāvatthi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ Rādham Bhagavā etad avoca || || Pariññeye ca dhamme desissāmi pariññañ ca pariññātāvim puggalaṃ ca taṃ suṇohi || pe || 4 Bhagavā etad avoca || || Katame ca Rādha pariññeyyā dhammā || || Rūpaṃ kho Rādha pariññeyyo dhammo || Vedanā pariññeyyo dhammo || Sañña || Saṅkhārā pariññeyyo dhammo || Viññāṇaṃ pariññeyyo dhammo || || Ime vuccanti Rādha pariññeyyā dhammā || || 5 Katamā ca Rādha pariññā || || Yo kho Rādha rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo ayaṃ vuccati Rādha pariññā || || 6 Katamo ca Rādha pariññātāvī puggalo || || Arahātissa vacanīyaṃ || yoyam āyasmā evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto ayam vuccati Rādha pariññātāvī puggalo ti || ||
